english.title: Scheme operator fail to provide authority with details of WEEE placed on market (pre 2019)

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: the Waste Electrical and electronic equipment regulations 2013

english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the operator of a scheme, failed to provide to **(..SPECIFY AUTHORITY..), the appropriate authority, information on the total amount in tonnes of electrical and electronic equipment that each member of that scheme had placed on the market in the United Kingdom in each

(A)_[compliance period]_
(B)_[part of a compliance period]_

during which his membership of that scheme subsisted, in accordance with regulation 37 of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013 in that **(..SPECIFY BREACH OF REGULATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 37, 90(3)(a) and 91(1) of the Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2013.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
being a scheme operator
failed to provide to appropriate authority information on amount in tonnes placed on market by scheme member
during compliance period or part of compliance period
in accordance with regulation 37

investigatoraction.description: Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)

Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Regulation 37 is superseded by regulation 38 on 1st January 2019
